name: std::counting_semaphore<LeastMaxValue>::try_acquire
intro: Tries to atomically decrement the internal counter by 1 if it is greater than 0; no blocking occurs regardless.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if it decremented the internal counter, otherwise false.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Implementations are allowed to fail to decrement the counter even if it was greater than 0 - i.e., they are allowed to spuriously fail and return false.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
